item.title: Admin Post - Info - Open
item.content:encoded:
Moved to Ideas Critique since there's no draft here.

Also noting that this:

An scp that knows everything there is know about the foundation, it's object class is: Thaumiel so it must be helpful? Well yes (sometimes) but mostly no, it hates almost everyone in foundation

Doesn't make sense for a Thaumiel anomaly. If it's not a reliable form of containment, it shouldn't be Thaumiel. Doesn't matter how overpowered and intelligent it is; if the Foundation can't trust it, they won't use it. Moving forward, I suggest reading over this essay on common SCP pitfalls to get an idea of what elements to avoid putting in an SCP article.

item.title: Scp idea
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: No

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: An scp that knows everything there is know about the foundation, it's object class is: Thaumiel so it must be helpful? Well yes (sometimes) but mostly no, it hates almost everyone in foundation (except for d-class personnel) as he thinks that most of the workers (including the scientists and the O5 council) are "stupid"

Central Narrative: if you bring any scp it will tell them something that they might know (example SCP-682- everyone hates you in the foundation)

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The fact that he knows everything about the scp
